children: Core Lightning said attackers are targeting nodes still running version 26.06.7 and earlier. According to ChainCatcher, the 26.06.8 patch released on September 22 fixed a channel-closing issue that could put funds at risk, along with vulnerabilities that could cause crashes and memory exhaustion.
The project has not disclosed the name of the vulnerability being exploited and has not reported any stolen funds. Node operators who have not yet upgraded are being targeted.

title: Core Lightning Warns Attackers Are Targeting Nodes Running Version 26.06.7 and Earlier
